text:
morgan_sales: Quick ask  MarlinPact wants to run a 3-day POC with their in-house model 'marlin-pact-7b'. They sent a GGML build and want embeddings+chat. Can SE/infra/security triage compatibility and blockers?
eli_se: Do they include tokenizer + vocab? GGML often missing tokenizer.
morgan_sales: They uploaded ggml.bin + tokenizer.json + README. They claim 8k context.
eli_se: 8k is fine. First checks: tokenizer type (bpe vs sentencepiece) and logits head layout. If tokenizer present, we can run a fast adapter test.
tess_infra: Infra note: marlin-pact-7b ggml @ 4-bit fits on a 48GB host for single-node. For concurrency >3 recommend Dedicated or sharding. If they want embeddings + chat concurrently, allocate separate worker pools to avoid KV contention.
eli_se: SE plan: build two variants (ggml-4bit and float16), run 200-query eval against their rubric, perf sweep at concurrency 1/3/5. ETA 2 business days after artifacts validated.
samira_security: Security: need license provenance and SCA. If README has redistribution restrictions, Hosted multi-tenant is blocked; Private or dedicated isolated host possible. Also request DPA if they will send PII in queries.
morgan_sales: Pricing? They asked rough POC cost and any one-time onboarding fee.
tess_infra: Ballpark Hosted isolated sandbox ~= $1.2k/day for 48GB node + ops. Dedicated minimal for 3 days ~= $6k-$8k depending on bandwidth/KMS. Variant validation fee ~= $750. Finance will confirm.
eli_se: High risk summary for sales email: 1) missing tokenizer could add ~1 day, 2) license terms may block Hosted, 3) embeddings+chat concurrency could need Dedicated.
morgan_sales: Good. I'll ask them to confirm tokenizer, license doc, and push eval set. Eli  please watch the staging bucket and start builds when ready.
task-bot: Created SE-4720 "MarlinPact marlin-pact-7b onboarding" assigned to eli_se, due 2024-10-03. :white_check_mark:
